title: Flying Domestic in NZ with Kids — Air NZ Tips, Baggage, and Seat Selection
meta_desc: Flying domestic in NZ with kids? Tips on Air NZ family seating, baggage, and routes from $49
intro: As a parent, navigating domestic flights in NZ with kids can be daunting, especially when it comes to choosing the right airline, seats, and routes. With prices starting from $49 for a one-way ticket from Auckland to Wellington, Air NZ offers a range of options for families. In this article, we'll dive into the specifics of flying domestic with kids on Air NZ, including baggage allowance and seat selection.

sections.heading: Choosing the Right Route
sections.body: When flying domestic with kids, it's essential to choose a route that suits your family's needs. Popular routes include Auckland to Queenstown, Christchurch, and Wellington. Consider the drive time from the airport to your accommodation, such as the 15-minute drive from Queenstown Airport to the city centre, or the 20-minute drive from Christchurch Airport to the city centre.

sections.heading: Air NZ Baggage Allowance
list: 1x checked bag (23kg) included in fare from $49
Car seats and strollers can be checked for free

sections.heading: Family Seating on Air NZ
sections.body: Air NZ offers a range of seating options for families, including the ability to book seats together. The 'Seat Select' option starts from $10 per person, per flight, and allows you to choose your seats in advance. You can also book a 'Skycouch' from $699, which converts a row of three seats into a couch.
